source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4.3 (PDF 216-217), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Sales strategies woh tactics (tareeqe) hain jin se customers ko aap ka product khareedne par tayyar kiya jata hai. Is mein discount (riyayat) dena, promotions chalana ya behtareen customer service dena shamil ho sakta hai.
Misal: Ramazan mein Pakistan ki bohat si grocery dukanein khane ki cheezon par khaas deals deti hain, jis se zyada log bulk (thok, yaani ek saath zyada miqdar) mein khareedari karte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Bohat se Pakistani karobar Ramazan aur Eid mein apni advertising (ishtihar) barha dete hain kyunke in dinon log zyada khareedari karte hain. Yeh sales barhane aur festival (tehwar) ke mausam se poora faida uthane ka soch samajh kar kiya gaya tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Farz karein aap apni pasand ka koi product bechne ka karobar shuru kar rahe hain. Apne karobar ke liye marketing aur sales strategy banayein. Sochein ke target market kaun hai, un tak kaise pohanchenge aur sales ke kaunse tactics istemal karenge. Apna plan class ke saath share karein.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: apni pasand ke product ki marketing aur sales strategy banayein. Is ke zaroori hisse kya hain, aur mukhtalif markets ke liye ise kaise dhalenge (long question 5)?
blocks.explanation: Hisse: target market aur us ki zarooratein; saaf brand aur paigham; customers tak pohanchne ke raaste (channels); qeemat; discount aur promotions jaise tactics; customer service; aur results naapne ka tareeqa. Dhalna: shehar ke kam umar khareedar Instagram, influencers aur online discount se; gaon ya bari umar ke khareedar local dukanon, radio ya word-of-mouth (logon ki zabani baat) se; aur Eid aur shadiyon ke mausam ke liye khaas offers.

items: Sales tactics: discount, promotions, achhi customer service; Ramazan aur Eid mein khaas offers.
